 Gold rate today: Gold rates showed a slight increase today in major Indian cities like Delhi, Mumbai, and Chennai. The rates reflect a rise compared to the previous day with increased demand anticipated during the festive season. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online Gold- silver rate today Gold rates increased marginally today (Monday, October 26, 2026) across major jewellery brands such as Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers, and Joyalukkas. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) is yet to update its daily gold and silver indicative jewellery prices today.
Gold prices are one of the important considerations for those planning to buy jewellery or investing in the precious metals this festive season.
 Gold-silver rate today (Monday, October 26, 2026)
Here is a look at today’s 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. 
Also have a look at the IBJA’s latest 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k and 14k indicative gold jewellery rates and the 999-purity silver jewellery price.

As of October 26, 2026, Tanishq's price of 22k gold jewellery is Rs 13,125 per gram across Delhi showrooms. On October 25, 2026, the 22k gold price at Tanishq in Delhi was Rs 13,110 per gram.
The current price of 22k gold jewellery at Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas is Rs 13,085 per gram each at their respective Delhi showrooms. On October 24, 2026, the 22k gold price at these brands in the city was Rs 13,070 per gram each.
